posts.title: Bookfool: A Personal Book Index
posts.description: I own a lot of books. And yet I continue to browse the stacks at used bookstores and swaps. I often find myself wondering if I have already picked up a given John McPhee or >DK Eyewitness volume. I also love distracting myself from actually reading those books!

posts.title: Good Enough: Digitizing Film at Home
posts.description: Movie film is a challenging form of media to preserve and share digitally. This is might be somewhat surprising. Unlike the ephemeral tape media standards of the 90s (looking at you Video8 and DAT), film enjoyed a long run as the de-facto format for capturing motion pictures. posts.description: Enough has been said about Tolkien's works that I won't much discuss the work here. Despite consuming much Tolkien-inspired media, I'd never read any of the Lord of the Rings series nor seen the Peter Jackson film series.
